title: audit detail session.model_switched
description: detail of audit rows with action session.model_switched: the runner moved a session to another model access because its access was used up, could not be used or was released again (ADR-081 sections 4 and 5), or continued a session whose access the provider refused once a renewed or another access was there (cause renewed, HOT-26; from_access and to_access may be equal), or holds a session whose subscription does not cover its model while no subscription with access to that model is free (cause model_unavailable, HOT-26; the session's model on both sides, until null): the access kinds and models before and after, the cause and the release time of the used-up access (null without one). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
